project_title: Personal AI-Powered Indian Stock Analysis & Portfolio Intelligence Platform
app_type: Data-Dense Quantitative Trading & Financial Research Terminal
archetype: The Performance Pro / Bloomberg Terminal Noir

design_principles.1_institutional_density: Prioritize high-density data presentation over wide consumer whitespace. Use compact grids, micro-type (11-13px) for data tables, and structured pane layouts.
design_principles.2_tactical_minimalism: Replace soft drop shadows with crisp 1px borders (`border-slate-800`), dark elevated surfaces, and glowing state indicators.
design_principles.3_semantic_financial_clarity: Strict color discipline: Emerald Green (#10B981) for Bullish/Profit, Crimson Red (#EF4444) for Bearish/Loss, Amber Gold (#F59E0B) for Watch/Warning, Electric Cyan (#38BDF8) for active selection/interactivity.
design_principles.4_clear_provenance_and_freshness: Prominently display Data Health status, Last Ingestion Timestamps, and STALE DATA / MOCK-DEMO DATA badges on all headers and analytical cards.
design_principles.5_deterministic_vs_ai_separation: Visually distinguish hard mathematical metrics (deterministic indicators, scores, price targets) from generative AI explanations using distinct card borders and AI badge tags.

body_sizes.badge: text-[11px] font-mono font-medium tracking-wide uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded

features: Live NIFTY 50 and BANKNIFTY index tickers with % change
Global Symbol Search with auto-suggest dropdown
DEMO / MOCK DATA warning banner badge

layout_and_navigation.bento_grid_structure: Dense grid layout using `grid-cols-12 gap-4`. Avoid empty gaps; maximize information per square inch while keeping 1px dark borders for crisp separation.

stock_analysis_tabs.interactive_charts: Recharts or Canvas candlestick charts with EMA 20/50/200, VWAP, Supertrend, Bollinger Bands, and RSI/MACD sub-panes.

trade_setup_card.styling: Dark elevated panel with highlighted Entry/Target/Stop Loss badges and progress gauge.

data_health_page.indicators: Pill statuses (OPERATIONAL / DEGRADED / DEMO-MOCK), Ingestion latency ms, and Last sync timestamps.

data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, input fields, filter options, and key informational metrics MUST include `data-testid` attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. `data-testid="stock-search-input"`, `data-testid="trade-setup-bias-badge"`).
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive dark-mode quantitative stock analysis platform tailored for Indian Equities (NSE/NIFTY 50).
Follow the compact institutional Bloomberg/TradingView terminal style using dark background `#090D16`, elevated panels `#0F172A`, 1px borders `#1E293B`, and `font-mono` for all numerical data.

Ensure all 10 main pages/views listed in the sidebar (Dashboard, Portfolio, Stock Analysis, NIFTY 50 Scanner, Long Term, Swing, Intraday, EVALS, Data Health, Settings) are fully accessible, highly functional, and populated with rich mock Indian stock market data (e.g., RELIANCE, TCS, HDFCBANK, INFYS, ICICIBANK, TATASTEEL, LT, etc.).
Always render prominent badges for 'DEMO/MOCK DATA' and 'STALE DATA' alerts to emphasize data provenance as required by the spec.

Include every required feature from the key functionalities specification including Candlestick/line charts with indicator overlays (EMA, VWAP, RSI, MACD), Trade Setup card with entry/stop-loss/targets/invalidation, sortable NIFTY 50 scanner table, EVALS suite, and Data Health observability status.
Attach `data-testid` to all primary buttons, tab triggers, search bars, table headers, and status chips.
